schema_classification.mutation_before_classification: none — classification reads PRAGMA user_version + physical schema with SELECTs only; the first write on any authorized path is the WAL pragma or the bootstrap/migration itself
schema_classification.fresh_empty: user_version 0 AND no application tables -> atomic v5 bootstrap
schema_classification.unversioned_existing: user_version 0 WITH existing tables -> refused, fail closed (proven: version + schema fingerprint identical before/after)
schema_classification.unknown_hybrid: refused, fail closed (proven: version + schema fingerprint identical before/after)

bootstrap.transaction_boundary: ONE explicit transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... per-statement DDL (no executescript inside) ... bootstrap provenance INSERT ... PRAGMA user_version = 5 ... COMMIT; any exception -> ROLLBACK (restores the pre-bootstrap isolation level)
bootstrap.executescript_discipline: executescript implicitly COMMITs any pending transaction (verified on this Python), so it never appears inside an explicit transaction; schema scripts run statement-by-statement via _execute_statements, which never commits
bootstrap.pre_digest: real sha256 of the empty schema (64 lowercase hex)
bootstrap.post_digest: real sha256 of the complete v5 schema, computed after all DDL, equal to the actual schema fingerprint (the ledger ROW is data and cannot move the digest)
bootstrap.digest_method: sha256 over repr() of plain (type, name, sql) tuples from sqlite_master ordered by name, excluding sqlite_% and sqlite_sequence (row inserts, including AUTOINCREMENT bookkeeping, cannot move the digest)
bootstrap.failure_rollback: proven: injected mid-bootstrap failure leaves user_version 0 and zero application tables
bootstrap.wording: the manifest calls this transactional only because it is one explicit transaction

schema.true_v4_source: P2-0004-runtime-governance-tables, verbatim from commit 61488273 (contains NEITHER runtime_execution NOR governance_approval_use)
schema.fresh_bootstrap: complete v5 shape in one transaction, then BOOTSTRAP-v5-complete-schema provenance row with real digests, then the version stamp
schema.hidden_completion: none — build_local_runtime verifies the physical shape and fails closed; it executes no schema DDL

legacy.v4_fingerprint: exact 13-table original-P2 set, all load-bearing columns, all 12 critical indexes, no post-v4 tables
legacy.post_v4_fingerprint: complete v4 set plus BOTH runtime_execution and governance_approval_use with their columns and the single-use unique index (legacy builds predate the R5R lookup indexes, which migration adds)
legacy.partial_shape_result: UNKNOWN_HYBRID, refused without mutation — proven by the section-9 counterexample (three key tables alone), missing-table, and missing-index fixtures
legacy.row_preservation: all historical rows preserved through legacy migration (proven per accepted shape)
legacy.migration_is_not_reconstruction: an incomplete schema is never accepted merely because migration DDL could CREATE IF NOT EXISTS the missing pieces

grant_binding.mismatch_law: changed budget / requirement / policy -> refused, never consumed
grant_binding.constraint_preservation: the durable ApprovalRequest schema cannot preserve per-request constraints, so record_authority_request fails closed on a constrained REQUIRE_APPROVAL verdict instead of silently narrowing it; the gate emits constraints == () and the guard pins that invariant

architecture.request_resolver: ApprovalRequestResolver.latest_for_step — the only owner, used by both admission and release
